lede: UNLV's Jazz & Commercial Music area has been running for more than fifty years. It's taught by working professionals — players, composers and arrangers active in the jazz and commercial music industries — which means the room our students learn in is run by people who still do the job.

degrees.programs: Instrumental Performance · Vocal Jazz Performance · Composition

curriculumNote: Alongside the traditional grounding in music history and theory, the curriculum is built for the industry students are actually walking into, with courses in The Business of Music, Film Scoring, Music Technology and Music Entrepreneurship.
downbeatNote: category wins and outstanding performance honors, for student compositions and arrangements and for Jazz Ensemble I, the Jazz Vocal Ensemble, Studio Scarlet Jazz Vocal Ensemble, the Latin Jazz Ensemble, the Joe Williams Honors Quartet, and the Contemporary Jazz Ensemble.
otherRecognition: Jazz Ensemble I and the Honors Trio have both won the Monterey Next Generation Jazz Festival. Individual students have taken regional and divisional awards in the commercial music categories of the National Association of Teachers of Singing. Our albums have drawn reviews in *DownBeat* and *JazzTimes*, and our 2025 release *Double or Nothing* received Grammy consideration.
touringNote: The program has toured internationally throughout its history, including trips to Europe, Africa, Japan and Australia, and has been invited to perform at:
stages: Jack Rudin Jazz Championship, Jazz at Lincoln Center
The Village Vanguard, New York City
guestArtistsNote: Students have taken masterclasses, recorded and performed with artists including Chris Potter, Bob Mintzer, Peter Erskine, Gerald Clayton, Tia Fuller, Manhattan Transfer and Take 6.
vegasNote: Because the program sits in Las Vegas, students also work professionally while they study — playing for Academy, Tony and Grammy winners, and for events including the Latin Grammy Awards and the Latin American Music Awards.
alumniNote: Graduates lead their own bands and work as performers, composers and arrangers with:
alumni: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra, directed by Wynton Marsalis
alumniClosing: J&CM alumni also teach at universities and colleges worldwide.
